name: Snark
source:
"My name...? For now, you can call me Snark. I admire the strong. Those who never lose sight of their goal and continue to grow... May those strong people find fortune."

A mysterious Luden who appears in Sagami City's subway system. He introduces himself as Snark. He looks like a station attendant, but his true identity is unknown. Well, I know it, but still.

Despite his immense power, he avoids getting directly involved in anything. Not out of fear or unwillingness—he's simply too powerful and doesn't want to alter the outcome unpredictably. His logic makes sense, honestly. Maybe he's some kind of tsundere?

Still, [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url] ends up borrowing a good deal of his power, but only partially... Is he a boojum? Or something else entirely...?

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category8&ch=snark]official website[/url]]
